messages:
incident-bot: [ALERT] 1765001234 — Sustained GPU pressure detected in eu-west-1 (gpu-pool-eu-west). Utilization >95% for 14m, autoscaler not recovering. Paging on-call: @raj. Severity: Sev2. Incident runbook: https://redwood.example/incidents/1765001234 :rotating_light:

raj: ack — I'm oncall. Pulling logs and autoscaler status now.

raj: autoscaler reports repeated allocation failures. error snippets:
```
ERROR: failed to attach instance: quotaExceeded (Insufficient capacity, API 429)
Autoscaler: retrying backoff 30s
```
Looks like regional capacity shortage / quota limits.

linda: joining. I'll check reserved pool and GC of idle nodes. Any customer-facing errors?

selena: customer-impact FYI — we've seen spike in 95th/99th latency for streaming/generation. 3 heavy customers with batch jobs timed out and retried. IDs: cust_prod_42, cust_nlp_alpha, cust_recommender-x. CS notified for immediate outreach.

marco: eu-central has available GPU capacity but model caches not warmed. We can route low-priority traffic to eu-central while we stabilize eu-west. Need to spin up 6 nodes and pre-warm the model KV caches. Command I recommend: `rdi infra scale --pool=eu-central-gpu --delta +6 --reason "emergency failover"`

raj: executing warmup now. `rdi infra scale --pool=gpu-pool-eu-central --delta +6` -> returned job id 8921. Starting pre-warmers (warm-ctx jobs).

(2m later)

raj: warmers started, streaming warmup logs:
```
WARMER: connecting to model shard a
WARMER: loading KV cache (approx 18GB)
WARMER: done warming 3/6
```

linda: checking autoscaler policy for eu-west: min=10, max=120, target_util=0.65. Right now pool at min nodes and heavy queue backlog. Proposed short-term mitigation: raise target_util to 0.55 -> effectively increases headroom and triggers scale up sooner. I'll patch policy for next 1h and monitor.

marco: routing rule applied: low-priority model traffic -> eu-central. Canary started at 5% traffic. No errors yet.

selena: CS update: outreach started for the 3 impacted customers, we're offering priority queue bump and postmortem once incident closed.

raj: confirmed autoscaler metric `allocation_failures` spiked. I'll open tracking ticket for root cause: `RG-342` (autoscaler: quota handling edgecases).

anne: thanks team. We need a post-incident review and clear action items. Suggest postmortem meeting tomorrow 09:00 UTC. Who can attend?

scheduler-bot: Created event "Sev2 eu-west GPU pressure — postmortem" for 2026-03-17 09:00 UTC. Link: https://calendar.example/evt/pm-1765001234

linda: I'll own follow-ups until handoff. Immediate actions I'm creating now:
- ticket RG-343: bump eu-west autoscaler headroom +20% for next 24h (owner: linda)
- ticket RG-344: add alert `allocation_failures > 3 / 10m` (owner: raj)

marco: I'll own warmup automation and cross-region failover playbook:
- GH-556: add automated warmers when routing to fallback region (owner: marco)
- GH-557: validate model quantization compatibility across regions (owner: marco)

raj: adding a short-term remediation checklist in the incident doc: patch autoscaler heuristics, enable quota prechecks, add capacity-reservation run.

selena: I'll coordinate customer follow-ups and add impact summary to the postmortem doc.

linda: quick handoff — I'm taking over monitoring at 08:30 UTC and will watch for re-appearance of allocation failures. raj handing off now.

raj: handing off — status:
- eu-west: utilization dropping to 82% after canary shift but still above target
- eu-central: 6 nodes warm, serving low-priority canary 5%
- tickets opened: RG-342, RG-343, RG-344
- customer-impact: 3 known customers affected; CS notified

raj: leaving notes in the doc: `incident-bot: close after 6h stable or manual close by owner`

linda: got it, thanks. I'll create remediation tracker table in the doc and assign owners + due dates. Quick rundown of action items I just added: 
- Remediate autoscaler quota handling (RG-342) — owner: raj — due 2026-03-19
- Autoscale headroom rule (RG-343) — owner: linda — due 2026-03-18
- Warmers & failover automation (GH-556) — owner: marco — due 2026-03-24
- Add allocation_failures alert (RG-344) — owner: raj — due 2026-03-17
- Customer outreach + postmortem summary (CS-1293) — owner: selena — due 2026-03-18

anne: please include expected impact if we don't do these (e.g., repeated regional shortages, customer churn). We'll review during postmortem.

marco: noted one blocker: quota soft-limits in eu-west cloud account. I'll open procurement request for reserved instances: TICKET-1293 (owner: anne)

linda: updates to remediation tracker added to the incident doc. I'm flagging RG-342 as P0 for tracking.

(1h later)

linda: monitoring update — allocation_failures alert triggered once after patch, scaled successfully, no new customer errors reported. Canary traffic slowly moved back to eu-west by 20% increments.

selena: CS: all 3 customers confirmed they recovered and accepted the priority assistance. No SLA credits requested yet.

raj: marking incident as mitigated in the doc. Next step: postmortem doc + RCA writeup. Everyone please add notes to the doc before the scheduled postmortem.

linda: I'll run the oncall handover at 12:00 UTC to the next shift and tag follow-up owners. Closing out monitoring watchlist — watch until 6h stable then we close incident.

anne: thanks all. Good triage + coordination. We'll review action items in postmortem and confirm capacity reservation plan.

scheduler-bot: Reminder scheduled: Postmortem in ~24h at 2026-03-17 09:00 UTC.

linda: final note before closing thread: remediation tracker snapshot:
- RG-342 (P0) autoscaler quota handling — raj — open
- RG-343 headroom temp patch — linda — in progress
- RG-344 alerting — raj — done
- GH-556 warmers automation — marco — in progress
- TICKET-1293 reserved capacity procurement — anne — open

linda: closing thread for now, will update incident doc with follow-ups. :white_check_mark:

selena: thx team :heart:
